Evidence

Apple guides its March-quarter gross margin below 45% on January 28
The pressure point is the coming quarter. Apple expects a 45% to 46% gross margin, compared with 47.9% in the quarter just reported. Gross margin is the share of sales left after direct product and service costs, before other business expenses.
Higher memory-chip and AI costs are part of the squeeze. The comparison also includes a benefit that will not necessarily repeat: tariff refunds lifted the reported quarter’s margin by about one percentage point.
